_about: Hand-checked Hebrew and Yiddish translation results for the Find your AI 'Translation' task (v16g). Intento tested one model generation older than the app's top models; shown as a note, not used for ranking. Edit by hand; update 'checked'.

source.name: Intento, The State of Translation Automation 2026

langs.line: Hebrew: Claude made the fewest mistakes of 11 AIs tested (16.5 per 1,000 words; GPT-5.6 Sol 20.4)
Yiddish: no AI is reliable yet; Claude made the fewest mistakes (44.2 per 1,000 words; GPT-5.5 54.7)

unit: weighted errors per 1,000 words, one-step translation (lower is better; the industry bar is 20)
